Inspect the first audio track without modifying the file.

Output:

    codec, and format. Bitrate is None when the audio stream omits it.

Raise ValueError for unreadable audio, missing metadata, or a probe timeout.

duration metadata; measure packet timestamps in that case.

This is a synchronous helper. An async service should call it through
run_in_threadpool so waiting for FFprobe does not block other requests.

Output: the path of the normalized WAV; the original file is not modified.

This does not remove noise, trim silence, or adjust loudness. Run this
synchronous helper in a worker thread. The caller owns temporary-file cleanup,
including any partial output when conversion fails.

work: Owns selected file, language, saved job, job ID, recording/pending state, limits, and feedback. Its mount effect loads server limits; failure is ignored because the server still enforces limits. Forms delegate to upload, lookup, and download handlers.
output: Recorder, upload form, saved-job lookup, transcript, timestamp list, and downloads.
summary: Owns selected file, language, saved job, job ID, recording/pending state, limits, and feedback. Its mount effect loads server limits; failure is ignored because the server still enforces limits. Forms delegate to upload, lookup, and download handlers.

name: AudioWorkspace.runAction
input: Status message and an async action callback.
work: Returns if disabled or already in flight. Uses a ref to block overlapping actions immediately, resets feedback, marks busy, awaits action, routes SessionExpiredError to App, and resets all busy flags in finally.
output: Completed action or visible error; no overlapping form requests.
summary: Returns if disabled or already in flight. Uses a ref to block overlapping actions immediately, resets feedback, marks busy, awaits action, routes SessionExpiredError to App, and resets all busy flags in finally.

name: AudioWorkspace.handleUpload
input: Upload form submit and currently selected File/language.
work: Prevents navigation, rejects missing/empty/oversize files, and uses runAction to await uploadAudio. Stores returned job and ID and displays a success notice.
output: SavedJob shown in the result section; error feedback if upload fails.
summary: Prevents navigation, rejects missing/empty/oversize files, and uses runAction to await uploadAudio. Stores returned job and ID and displays a success notice.

name: AudioWorkspace.handleLookup
input: Saved-job form submit and jobId text.
work: Prevents navigation, trims the ID, ignores empty values, and uses runAction to call loadAudioJob.
output: Existing owned job loaded into the result section.
summary: Prevents navigation, trims the ID, ignores empty values, and uses runAction to call loadAudioJob.

name: AudioWorkspace.handleDownload
work: Uses runAction to fetch an original or exported transcript Blob, creates a temporary object URL and download link, clicks and removes the link, then schedules URL revocation after one second.
output: Browser download and success notice; filenames strip client path components for originals.
summary: Uses runAction to fetch an original or exported transcript Blob, creates a temporary object URL and download link, clicks and removes the link, then schedules URL revocation after one second.

name: GoogleLoginButton
work: Keeps the latest callback in a ref. On mount, initializes the available Google Identity SDK with VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and renders its button. Tracks pending/error feedback; if SDK or button ref is absent, initialization returns.
output: Google sign-in button and request feedback.
summary: Keeps the latest callback in a ref. On mount, initializes the available Google Identity SDK with VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and renders its button. Tracks pending/error feedback; if SDK or button ref is absent, initialization returns.

name: GoogleLoginButton.handleCredentialResponse
work: POSTs JSON to API_URL + /auth/google with cookies included, checks HTTP success, then awaits the latest App onLogin callback. Catches errors and clears pending in finally.
output: Login cookies from backend and refreshed App user state, or a visible login error.
summary: POSTs JSON to API_URL + /auth/google with cookies included, checks HTTP success, then awaits the latest App onLogin callback. Catches errors and clears pending in finally.

name: Login
work: Renders the login screen and GoogleLoginButton; forwards the callback. Decorative feature cards and waveform have no processing logic.
output: Google sign-in UI.
summary: Renders the login screen and GoogleLoginButton; forwards the callback. Decorative feature cards and waveform have no processing logic.
